assessment: The proposal is scientifically defensible and faithful to the source. Both eligible branches are preserved with their different priors explicitly kept apart for grading (analytic power-law hyperprior vs HalfNormal(10) x potential in the MCMC branch), matching the notebook. The terminal endpoints are well covered: the analytic grid is deterministic and its row order, columns and 40,000-cell layout were confirmed against the recorded reference (first rows show X ascending -2.3, -2.29, ... at fixed Z=1.0, i.e. z-outer/x-inner exactly as the task brief specifies); the four scalar posterior-mean estimates are unnamed display expressions in the source, and the handoff correctly routes them to construction recovery rather than demanding new export-time computation. Exclusions are the posterior-mode annotation (relabeled preference with the full grid exported and its argmax recoverable), arviz diagnostic plots, and theta/X/Z draws, all plot-consumed or pointwise transforms of retained quantities; these are source-backed. The MCMC branch is defined as a statistical quantity (posterior mean of the exact model), and the handoff correctly refuses to treat the recorded draws, observed .nc byte hashes or chain/draw labels as an answer key — the target is the free-seed posterior-mean estimate, not bit-identity. The proposed inputs/rat_tumor_counts.csv materialization is a verbatim, order-preserving transcription of the 71 embedded (y,n) pairs with an explicit construction obligation (hash-pin, 71-row and y<=n checks); the likelihood is a product over i, so the permutation-invariance claim is sound and only within-row pairing is scientifically load-bearing. Solver-facing text does not leak answers. Downstream obligations (recorded, not blocking): (1) MC-error tolerances for the MCMC means are unmeasured — validation must run repeated reference executions and ideally independent numerical integration of the exact MCMC posterior mean before fixing tolerances; the .nc byte-level non-reproducibility and unquantified mean drift are correctly flagged by the handoff. (2) Cell identity should use coordinate tolerances rather than string equality (arange float artifacts such as "-2.2800000000000002" are confirmed in the reference CSV). (3) The setup environment's dependency scan found 2942 candidates and no answer-bearing fixture; candidate/dependency-exclusions.json is empty, and construction still owes the final verified-removal/inspection receipt for any staged assets. (4) The .nc was written via netcdf4 after the h5py repair — serialization detail, sample values unchanged; the reference files remain private. (5) Redistribution review for the derived input CSV remains open before publication. None of these affect the scientific definition of the question, and the handoff does not change its quantity, population, required inputs, identity rules or source coverage.
